notes: Not checked or not resolved: (1) NI, Rockwell Automation and Sandvik each have a confirmed Bengaluru presence (jobs, or a design centre for Rockwell), but no source gives an address; their OSM-only offices stay at low. (2) The Rakuten building (Bagmane Pallavi Towers) rests on OSM plus a consistent company description, never a named source. (3) The Saviynt pin assumes the LEI/Smartworks address is current; the Oct 2025 62k sq ft hub may be elsewhere. Saviynt's Dec 2025 KKR round, which could make it a unicorn, was not checked, so isUnicorn is unchanged. (4) Reckitt was dropped on the absence of any source beyond a ~2015 OSM POI; a regional sales branch may exist. (5) Pandorum's own site returned 503 throughout; the BBC HQ rests on directories plus a C-CAMP document. (6) sap.com's India page and the Netsmart BusinessWire release returned 403 to a direct fetch; their content was read through search snippets. (7) Rinac's Magadi Road factory (Marenahalli, Tavarekere Hobli) and its Ulsoor registered office were not added: the factory is likely outside the city box and the registered office is not operational.
